page.layout: One page of text; headings at full width at top; main text in one column with page-date notes ("A. C.", numbers) in the right margin; running head and signature at foot. Faint show-through of the reverse page at top is ignored.

main_text.head: INDEX I. CHRONOLOGICUS, Seu CHRONICON ECCLESIAE ROMANAE.
main_text.p: Quo res in historia Ecclesiae Romanae narratae, juxta Seculorum annorumque seriem, breviter digeruntur.
main_text.head: SECULUM PRIMUM.
main_text.p: Ecclesiâ ob persecutionem dispersâ, Andronicus & Junias, insignes inter Apostolos, Saulis persecutoris cognati, & ante ipsum ad Christum conversi, Romam perrexisse, atque ibi Christum praedicâsse videntur, Rom. xvi. 7. Paulo mox eorum, vel aliorum etiam opera, secundum Evangelium suum, Romanos Christo lucrifaciente, & in agnita veritate confirmante. ib. v. 25. §. II.A. C. 34
S Paulus Romanis fidem in toto orbe celebrem gratulatur. §. III.60.
S. Ignatius Romanam Ecclesiam insignibus elogiis mactat. §. IV.91.
main_text.head: SECULUM SECUNDUM.
main_text.p: POst Apostolorum tempora Ecclesia virgo casta esse definit. §. VI. VII.101.

page.notes: Marginal note "A. C." is a heading for the date column, with the dates 34, 60, 91, 101 beside the lines. The large woodcut initial "E" is joined to "Ecclesiâ". The reference "§. I. — VI." and similar are section ranges. Some letters in the top running title area are faint show-through and were not transcribed.
